entity.description: One run of a pipeline for a commit of a repository: its jobs are GitJobRun rows.

field.name: runNum
field.description: Per repository from 1

field.name: definitionSource
field.description: file (ci.xml at the commit) or builtin (a component repository with no ci.xml)

field.name: event
field.description: push, merge-request, tag, schedule, manual or deploy

field.name: refName
field.description: The full ref the run is for (refs/heads/main, refs/tags/v1); a merge request's target branch ref for its event

field.name: sourceRepositoryId
field.description: The fork a merge request comes from, when it does

field.name: ownerId
field.description: Whose secrets and usage the run counts under, as the application's run check gave it (a group, an account); empty when it gave none

field.name: trusted
protectedRef
field.description: Y when a branch rule names the ref (or, for a merge request, never): a secret of the protected or tags scope is given only then

field.name: hidden
field.description: Y for a run of a hidden merge request's head: read only with authorization disabled, or by the merge request's author

field.name: approvalState
field.description: none, waiting or approved

field.name: statusId
field.description: waiting (for approval), queued, running, success, failure, error or cancelled

field.name: statusMessage
field.description: Why it is an error, was refused or waits

entity.description: A pipeline of a repository's default branch that runs on schedule, kept by the engine whenever that branch moves, so the schedule job reads no file.

field.name: refName
field.description: The branch it runs on

field.name: lastCheckDate
field.description: It runs when its cron came due after this

entity.description: One job of a pipeline run, run once in a container or on a registered runner. Its commit status has the context ci/pipeline/job.

field.name: matrixKey
field.description: The matrix values, joined by a comma and a space; empty with no matrix

field.name: attempt
field.description: From 1; a retry makes a new row with the next

field.name: superseded
field.description: Y once a retry replaced it: the run's state and the jobs that need it follow the newest attempt

field.name: needs
field.description: The job names it waits for, separated by spaces

field.name: poolName
field.description: The pool the file asks for

field.name: runnerPoolId
field.description: The pool it runs in, once chosen

field.name: runnerId
field.description: The registered runner that took it

field.name: statusId
field.description: waiting (for the jobs it needs, or for the run's approval), queued, running, success, failure, error, cancelled or skipped (a job it needs did not succeed)

field.name: jobSpec
field.description: The job as planned, JSON: what the runner is given

field.name: instanceRef
field.description: The container's id on the host

field.name: tokenHash
field.description: The SHA-256 of the job token; cleared when the job ends

field.name: logBlobId
field.description: The whole log, once the job has ended

field.name: nextChunkSeq
field.description: The sequence the next log chunk takes, from 1

field.name: minutesUsed
field.description: Started minutes of runner time

field.name: commitStatusId
field.description: The latest GitCommitStatus it wrote

field.name: lastContactDate
field.description: When its runner last called

field.name: stepSeq
field.description: From 1, in the job's order

field.name: statusId
field.description: pending, running, success, failure or skipped

field.name: firstChunkSeq
field.description: The first log chunk of the step

entity.description: Lines of a running job's log, as its runner sent them, secrets masked. Removed when the job ends and its log becomes one content blob (GitJobRun.logBlobId).

field.name: byteOffset
field.description: Where the chunk starts in the whole log

entity.description: A file a job uploaded, a content blob: an artifact (a tar.gz of the files), a report (one JUnit XML file) or a cache (a tar.gz of the directory, by key).

field.name: artifactKind
field.description: artifact, report or cache

field.name: cacheKey
field.description: A cache's key, hashes and matrix values expanded

field.name: protectedRef
field.description: A cache written by a run for a protected ref: such a run reads only these, and any other run reads both

field.name: keep
field.description: Y: not removed when it expires

field.name: lastUsedDate
field.description: When a cache was last restored

entity.description: A test that failed in a job, from its JUnit reports.

A secret a job may ask for (a secret element in ci.xml), of a repository or of an owner the application names (a group, an account). Given only to a job of a trusted run: for the protected scope on a protected branch or tag, for tags on a protected tag, for environment in the job's environment. Its value is never read back by a service.

field.name: scope
field.description: protected, tags or environment

entity.description: A place a repository deploys to, which scopes secrets. The target, the pipeline that must have passed and the approval are for deployments (plans/Dogfood.md §8.6, DG10).
Where jobs run: containers started on an InstanceHost through its host type's run services, or the registered runners of the pool. A job's pool attribute names poolName.

field.name: poolName
field.description: What a job's pool attribute names; default is the pool of a job that names none

field.name: ownerId
field.description: Set by an application that gives a pool to one owner

field.name: poolKind
field.description: container or registered

field.name: trusted
field.description: Y: takes trusted runs only. N: takes untrusted runs, and only those.

field.name: maxConcurrent
field.description: Jobs running at once; 1 when empty

field.name: allowedImages
field.description: Image patterns (* is any run of characters), separated by spaces or lines. A job whose image none matches is an error. Empty allows none.

field.name: cpuLimit
field.description: CPUs of a job's container

field.name: diskMb
field.description: The container's writable layer, where the host's storage driver can limit it

field.name: maxMinutes
field.description: The longest a job of the pool runs

field.name: egressRule
field.description: The container's network mode: bridge (the default), none, or the name of a network of the host whose rules limit what a job reaches

field.name: serverUrl
field.description: The URL the pool's runners reach this server by; the conf's git-ci server-url, else the public URL, when empty

field.name: registrationTokenHash
field.description: The SHA-256 of the token a runner registers with (poolKind registered)

entity.description: A registered runner: a long-lived machine that asks its pool for jobs.

field.name: platform
field.description: What it said it is (macos-arm64)

field.name: statusId
field.description: active or revoked

entity.description: The runner time of one job run, written when it ends, so an application can keep a quota.

field.name: periodKey
field.description: The month it ended in, yyyy-MM (UTC)

field.name: minutesUsed
field.description: Started minutes

entity.description: A commit asked to be deployed to an environment (plans/Dogfood.md §8.6). The engine queues the environment's pipeline with the deploy event; the approval, the deploy step and the gate are DG10.

field.name: statusId
field.description: running, waiting, approved, refused, deployed or failed
